question: If Shattering Spree was cast with replicate and the original is countered, do I still copy Shattering Spree for each time I paid its replicate cost?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: as the replicate trigger resolves, you copy it for each time you paid, even if the original is no longer on the stack.
expected.answer: As the replicate triggered ability resolves, you'll copy Shattering Spree for each time you paid its replicate cost, even if the original spell is no longer on the stack at that time (perhaps because it was countered).
